Requirements: Reach Inter-Knot Lv. 4 before 2026/07/29 06:00 (UTC+8).

▶ Shiyu Defense
After the Version 3.1 update, the buff effects of Critical Node are as follows:
Phase I:
• If there are 2/3 Agents with the Anomaly specialty in the squad, Attribute Anomaly DMG dealt by Agents increases by 10%/60%, and the whole squad initially gains 500/1,500 Decibels upon entering combat.
• Agent's Ultimate and Chain Attack DMG increase by 40%. When Chain Attack hits an enemy, the enemy's Stun DMG Multiplier increases by 20% and their Daze recovery slows down by 15%, lasting 15s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.
• Agent Ice DMG and Electric DMG increase by 30%. After an Attack specialty Agent uses an EX Special Attack, their CRIT DMG increases by 30% for 20s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.

Phase II:
• Attribute Anomaly DMG dealt by Agents increases by 15%. If there are 2/3 Agents in the squad with the Anomaly specialty, Agent Anomaly Proficiency increases by 40/120.
• Agent Ether DMG increases by 20%. When an enemy is inflicted with an Attribute Anomaly, their DEF is reduced by 15%, and All-Attribute RES is reduced by 15% for 10s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.
• When an Attack Agent lands Basic Attacks on an enemy, they ignore 30% of the enemy's Ice RES. After an Attack Agent uses a Chain Attack or EX Special Attack, their Ice DMG increases by 20%, and CRIT DMG increases by 40% for 15s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.

Phase III:
• Agent Ether DMG and Ice DMG increase by 35%, while their CRIT DMG increases by 25%. When an Attack Agent hits a Stunned enemy, the enemy's DEF decreases by 25% for 5s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.
• If there are 2/3 Agents with the Anomaly specialty in the squad, Attribute Anomaly DMG dealt by Agents increases by 10%/60%, and the whole squad initially gains 500/1,500 Decibels upon entering combat.
• On hit, Agent attacks ignore 20% of the enemy's Electric RES. After an Agent uses an EX Special Attack, their CRIT Rate increases by 5%, and CRIT DMG increases by 20% for 15s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.

▶ Deadly Assault
After the Version 3.1 update, the enemies featured in Deadly Assault are as follows:
Phase I:
Girtablullu - Stagnant Aberrant, Notorious - Dead End Butcher, Unknown Corruption Complex

Phase II:
Girtablullu - Stagnant Aberrant, Ye Shiyuan the Thrall, Miasma Priest

Phase III:
Dead End Butcher, Girtablullu, Primordial Nightmare - "The Creator"

▶ Hollow Zero
• Adds Tactical Prism Programs for Agents Remielle and Sigrid, along with their corresponding Task Force Missions.

Adjustments & Optimizations
• Optimizes the auto-selection logic for W-Engines in the Storage panel on the left side of the W-Engine recommendation interface. The corresponding W-Engine with a higher level and overclock phase will now be selected.
• Adjusts the EXP required to level up from Level 20 to Level 50, reducing overall leveling time for a smoother progression pace.
• Optimizes the control feel and transition timing of some of Agent Rina's skills.
• Reduces the ATK of all enemies at different HP thresholds in Deadly Assault's Trial Mode.
• Removes the "Events Calendar" entry from the Events tab. Proxies can still view it via the Announcements system.
• Adjusts the "Bangbang! The Genius and the Miracle Chip" gameplay: After the Collaboorator reaches max level, the Daily Quests rewards will be updated to Bangboo Module reconstruction items.
• Optimizes the display experience of some tips and tags in the "Bangbang! The Genius and the Miracle Chip" gameplay.
• Adjusts the crafting of Prepaid Power Cards using "Deep Cleaning" Service Cards to the Outpost Logistics interface. Proxies can now use "Deep Cleaning" Service Cards to exchange for Prepaid Power Cards.
• Optimizes the experience of certain red dot notifications in the Compendium.
• Optimizes the rules related to the Drive Disc's Smart Discard function.
• Optimizes the Teleport location at Booastrum City District - Video Store Branch to prevent accidental activation.
• Optimizes some visual effects and art presentation of Booastrum.
• Optimizes some visual effects and art presentation of Fantasy Resort.
• Adjusts the default graphics quality settings for certain iPhone models (iPhone 12, iPhone 13, etc.).
• Fixes some text typos.
• Adjusts, improves, and fixes the in-game text for some languages. These changes will not affect gameplay or functions.
• Optimizes English, Japanese, and Korean voice-overs for story scenes and combat sequences of previous versions.

Issue Fixes
▶ Agents & Enemies
• Fixes an issue where certain enemies had abnormal Anti-Interrupt levels.
• Fixes an issue in Hollow Zero: Operation Matrix where, under certain circumstances, using Auxiliary Agent Manato's Auxiliary Assist could cause subsequent Agent Ultimate activations to behave abnormally.
• Fixes an issue in Hollow Zero: Operation Matrix where Pyrois's Ultimate would trigger abnormally after using Auxiliary Agent Manato's Lv. 4 Auxiliary Assist.
• Fixes an issue in Hollow Zero: Operation Matrix where, after Agent Evelyn is equipped with the Gear Lethal Etiquette, hitting an enemy with any squad member's Quick Assist would fail to properly restore Burning Embers for Evelyn.
• Fixes an issue in Hollow Zero: Operation Matrix where, after Agent Cissia is equipped with the Gear Coiled Strike, the Chain Attack window would open abnormally when Cissia was not on-field.
• Fixes an issue during combat against Integrated: Shining Promise - Billy in Annihilation Simulacrum, where Agents within the Starlight Arena area might not correctly obtain Etch.
• Fixes an issue where Agent Pyrois's actions could appear abnormal on the Agent menu.
Fixes an issue on the Agent Selection screen where Agent Promeia's hair was displayed abnormally.
• Fixes an issue where some of Agent Norma's actions could appear abnormal.
• Fixes visual issues affecting the models for some Agents and NPCs.
• Fixes an issue in Deadly Assault where, during combat against the enemy Girtablullu, Girtablullu could recover from the Stunned state with an abnormal Stun DMG Multiplier.
• Fixes an issue where Agent Soldier 0 - Anby failed to properly hit enemies under certain circumstances after activating Ultimate: Voidstrike.

▶ Systems
• Fixes an issue where stuttering occurred when entering the game for the first time in DX12 mode. To ensure a smooth gameplay experience after this update, launching with DX12 will trigger a one-time shader compilation.
• Fixes an issue where progress for New Eridu City Fund's Expansion Tasks might not be correctly recorded after participating in Notorious Hunt.
• Fixes an issue where the title management interface could display abnormally or have errors when swapping titles.

▶ Music & SFX
• Fixes an issue where some voice lines in certain languages might be missing when using the 2x speed playback function during the story.
• Fixes an issue where music and sound effects could behave abnormal in certain circumstances.

▶ Environments
• Fixes an issue where scene visuals could appear abnormal in certain circumstances.

▶ Others
• Fixes text and punctuation errors in some missions, interfaces, and descriptions.

Agent Skills, W-Engine & Drive Disc Text Optimizations
▶ Agents
• Updates Agent Hoshimi Miyabi's Additional Ability: Bask in Frost effect.
Before update: When another character in your squad is a Support character or shares the same faction
After update: When another character in your squad is a Support or Anomaly character, or shares the same faction

After update: When another character in your squad is a Stun, Support, or Anomaly character, or shares the same faction

After update: When another character in your squad is an Anomaly character, or shares the same attribute or faction

title: How to Fix the Issue of Linking the Wrong HoYoverse Account
summary:
Dear Proxies,

We've received feedback today that, when logging in via Steam, some users accidentally used a third-party account's email to create a new HoYoverse account and link it to Steam, resulting in their inability to log in to their original game account or unlink it on their own.

If you have encountered this issue, you can resolve it using the following method:

1. Go to: https://cs.hoyoverse.com/new-csc-new-os-account-retrieve-fe/index.html?channel_id=212&token=12b45097-ba0f-4854-a278-226f81c5037e#/

2. In the HoYoverse Account Issues Application form, select "I need to unlink my (one/several) third-party account(s)," then select Steam as the third-party platform and enter the corresponding Steam account name (optional).

3. Enter the email address we can use to contact you in the "New Email Address" field.

4. In the "Please enter your game account UID" field, enter the UID associated with the incorrectly linked HoYoverse account (i.e., the UID displayed in the bottom-right corner of the game after logging in to the incorrectly linked account via Steam).

5. If your appeal is approved, launch the game again via Steam. On the "Link HoYoverse Account" page, use the QR code login method to link your original third-party account. When scanning the QR code on a mobile device, tap "More Login Options" and log in to your HoYoverse account via third-party login.

Note: Logging in by directly entering your username/email may result in linking the HoYoverse account that was accidentally created during the linking process again.

*If you have any questions about the instructions above, or if your unbinding appeal was not approved, please contact our customer support team, and include your in-game UID, server region, platform, a description of your issue, and any relevant screenshots.

Customer Service Email:

https://zzz_cs@hoyoverse.com

The Extreme stage is much tougher, with enemies dealing significantly more damage and having greatly increased HP. Upon clearing the Extreme stage, the system records the fastest clear time and ranks them on a server-wide leaderboard.

title: Zenless Zone Zero Steam Version Launches June 17
summary:
Zenless Zone Zero officially launches on Steam on June 17!
Steam Preload for Zenless Zone Zero Is Now Available:
https://hoyo.link/qqMvGg8Me
The Steam version will be cross-compatible with existing mobile, PC, PS5, and Xbox platforms. Version 3.0 content will also be available at launch!

▼ Add to Wishlist
https://hoyo.link/qqMvGg8Me

▌ Launch Details
Launch Date: After the Version 3.0 update on 2026/06/17
Supported Servers: Europe, America, Asia, and TW/HK/MO servers

▌ System Requirements
Recommended Specifications: 10th Gen Intel Core i7, 8GB RAM, Nvidia GeForce GTX1660 or better
Minimum Specs: 7th Gen Intel Core i5, 8GB RAM, Nvidia GeForce GTX970 or better
System Requirements: Windows 10 64-bit or later, DirectX 11.1 or later
Storage Requirements: 75GB of available space required

▌ FAQ

※Account-Related
Q: How do I link my Steam account with my HoYoverse account?
A: When logging into Zenless Zone Zero via Steam for the first time, Proxies will need to link their Steam account with their HoYoverse ID. You can follow the in-game guidance and complete the account linking process using one of the following two methods.
Option 1: If you have already created a HoYoverse ID, we recommend using that to log in. When you launch Zenless Zone Zero for the first time on Steam, select "Login with existing HoYoverse ID," and then link up your existing HoYoverse ID with your Steam account as per the prompts.
Option 2: Use your Steam account to create a new HoYoverse ID. When you launch Zenless Zone Zero for the first time on Steam, select "Create HoYoverse ID now" to log in to the game.

Q: If I link an existing HoYoverse account, will the Steam version of Zenless Zone Zero inherit my progress from other platforms?
A: Yes, your progress will carry over. This Steam advance test uses the official version of Zenless Zone Zero. If the HoYoverse account you link already has an existing Zenless Zone Zero game account, your progress will transfer to the Steam version once the link is complete. Since the Steam version of Zenless Zone Zero supports America, Europe, Asia, and TW/HK/MO servers, Proxies should confirm after linking that they've selected the correct server where their existing progress is stored.

Q: I selected [Create HoYoverse ID now] when logging into the Steam version of Zenless Zone Zero for the first time. Can I use this account to continue playing on other platforms?
A: Yes. If you created a new account on the Steam version of Zenless Zone Zero and wish to play Zenless Zone Zero on other platforms, please ensure that your HoYoverse account has an email address linked to it. If no email is linked, you can complete the linking process in the User Center webpage. Once linked, you can log in on other platforms using your email address.

Q: How do I unlink my Steam account from my HoYoverse account?
A: You can log in to the User Center webpage and complete the unlinking process on the linked accounts page by following the guide. Please note that before unlinking, you must ensure that the HoYoverse account linked to that Steam account has an email address linked to it, otherwise unlinking will not be possible.
User Center URL: https://account.hoyoverse.com/

※ Payment Related
Q: Can I make in-game purchases normally when playing Zenless Zone Zero on Steam? (Such as purchasing Monochromes, Inter-Knot Membership, New Eridu City Fund, etc.)
A: You can make purchases normally. The in-game items available for purchase are the same as on the other platform clients. You can simply follow the guide within the client to complete your purchase.

Q: Can I use items from top-ups on other platforms or Steam (such as Monochromes, Inter-Knot Memberships, etc.) across different platforms?
A: You can, once you've linked your accounts. When switching platforms, all items received from top-ups will be displayed and can be used normally.

Q: I registered a new game account on the Steam version. Can I make purchases for account on other platforms?
A: You can make purchases on any platform. ※ Please note: If you select "Create HoYoverse ID now" when first logging in to the Steam version of Zenless Zone Zero, you will create a new game character on Steam.

※ Other Issues
Q: Does the Steam version of Zenless Zone Zero support pre-downloading new version updates via the HoYoPlay launcher before the update goes live?
A: The Steam version of Zenless Zone Zero does not currently support pre-downloading new versions of the game via the HoYoPlay launcher. After server maintenance begins for each update, Proxies can head to their Steam library to download and install the latest version of the game.

Q: Can the game's Resource Management function be used in the Steam version of Zenless Zone Zero?
A: Apologies, but the Steam version of Zenless Zone Zero does not currently support the Resource Management function. When playing the Steam version of Zenless Zone Zero, the full game assets will be downloaded and installed by default for all Proxies, and resource deletion is not available.
